caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting a wrought iron balcony railing. The railing is composed of vertical and horizontal bars forming a rectangular structure, with the front and right side panels visible. The central section of the front panel features a large, symmetrical, radiating floral or sunburst pattern with a circular center and petal-like shapes extending outward. Each side panel contains elongated oval loops arranged vertically, with decorative elements placed at the intersections of the bars. Beneath the main railing, there is a horizontal strip with a pattern consisting of swirling scrollwork and ovals. The left corner of the railing is topped with a finial that has a rounded, ornamental shape. The balcony sits atop wooden planks shown with wood grain texture, which extend beyond the railing, and is supported by several exposed joists underneath. Behind the balcony, a window with divided panes is visible, featuring four rectangular sections and diagonal hatch marks suggesting glass reflection. The drawing is bordered by a single line with rounded corners, and at the bottom of the image, the text “WROUGHT IRON BALCONY RAILING” is inscribed in capital letters with decorative dots and lines.
title: Iron Balcony Railings
